title.zh: 工具描述是写给模型看的说明书
title.en: Tool Descriptions Are Manuals Written for the Model

subtitle.zh: AI-FDE 转型之路 · AI 工程 06-Tool-Calling
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 06 — Tool Calling

summary.zh: 模型缺的不是智力，是数据、算力和手脚。工具该怎么分类、怎么接，以及为什么一行工具描述就能决定它调不调用。
summary.en: What the model lacks isn't intelligence but data, arithmetic and hands. How to classify and connect tools — and why one line of tool description decides whether it gets called.
